issues.description: The problem statement requires the Lecture constructor to initialize attributes in the order from the UML (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). The solution's constructor signature uses a different parameter order (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This mismatch between the specification and the provided solution can confuse students about the expected constructor parameter order and will cause problems if tests or instructions assume the UML order.
issues.suggestedFix: Adjust the constructor parameter order in the solution (and/or template/tests) to match the UML and problem description: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) { ... } and assign fields accordingly. Ensure any tests or documentation expect the same order.
